note: Alternative thresholds for founderReview.md B3: brakes on the fall in value (open positions included), daily and weekly only. Monthly windows and losing-exit streaks are left off: for a bot that rebalances monthly they trip on the planned rebalance itself, after the fall is over (the 2020 crash replay). Set with: npm run protections -- set docs/policies/protections-equity.json --reason "...". Pauses hold new buys only and lift by themselves.
